note: SCR-01G (Keen 6): the control panel's cards from the title, reached as the intro ends (Escape on the title at 33 s: a key that cuts the intro short opens the panel at once in the user's v1.0 and shows the title first in v1.4, which the port plays, J-19). CONFIGURE and its cards are left out: v1.0's differ from v1.4's (J-19; Keen 4 and 5 cover them). Keys 1.75 s apart, between two blinks of the cursor. Times are seconds after the EGA mode set (KEYFEED.COM types the keys in DOS).
